dashboard.label: SASP - AI System Health
dashboard.description: Health and performance monitoring for SASP AI agents, guardian, and Ollama endpoints

search.query: index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics | stats avg(response_time_ms) AS avg_ms p95(response_time_ms) AS p95_ms p99(response_time_ms) AS p99_ms by agent_name | eval avg_ms=round(avg_ms,1), p95_ms=round(p95_ms,1), p99_ms=round(p99_ms,1) | rename agent_name AS "Agent", avg_ms AS "Avg (ms)", p95_ms AS "P95 (ms)", p99_ms AS "P99 (ms)"
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics agent_name=guardian | stats count by validation_result | rename validation_result AS "Result"

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics event_type=tool_call | stats count(eval(status="success")) AS success count(eval(status="failure")) AS failure by tool_name | eval success_rate=round((success/(success+failure))*100,1) | table tool_name success failure success_rate | rename tool_name AS "Tool", success AS "Success", failure AS "Failure", success_rate AS "Success Rate %"
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics event_type=ollama_health | timechart avg(response_time_ms) AS avg_response_ms by endpoint
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics status=error | timechart count by agent_name
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics event_type=human_approval status=pending | stats count

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:agent_metrics event_type=human_approval status=pending | table _time investigation_id agent_name action_requested risk_level | sort - _time | rename investigation_id AS "Investigation", agent_name AS "Agent", action_requested AS "Action", risk_level AS "Risk Level"
